summary: Nginx on node1 now serves HTTP 200 at / on TCP port 6500.
actions_performed: Created a dedicated server block listening on IPv4 and IPv6 port 6500.
Authorized port 6500 for HTTP under SELinux.
Opened TCP 6500 in the runtime and permanent firewalld configuration.
Validated the configuration and enabled and started Nginx.

evidence.requirement: Successful Nginx HTTP response at / on TCP port 6500
evidence.summary: A request to http://$NODE_IP:6500/ returned HTTP/1.1 200 OK from nginx with the expected response body.

evidence.requirement: Nginx configuration is valid and service is persistent
evidence.summary: nginx -t succeeded; the service is active and enabled, with Nginx listening on 0.0.0.0:6500 and [::]:6500.
Firewalld reports port 6500/tcp allowed in both runtime and permanent configurations, and SELinux maps TCP 6500 to http_port_t.
